name: Side Chat
description: A docked sidebar chat that talks with your signed-in models, can attach the current session as context, and can send a reply back into that session.

en.name: Side Chat
en.description: A docked sidebar chat that talks with your signed-in models, can attach the current session as context, and can send a reply back into that session.
en.safetyNotes: Uses your already signed-in models through the host (agent.complete); the plugin never sees API keys. desktop.control lets it list sessions, read a transcript, and send a prompt into a session. Conversations are stored only in this plugin's local data directory. No network of its own.

zh-CN.name: 侧边聊天
zh-CN.description: 停靠在右侧工作面板的独立聊天：走你已登录的模型，可把当前会话当上下文，也能把回复发回该会话。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 通过宿主调用你已登录的模型（agent.complete），插件拿不到 API 密钥。desktop.control 用于列出会话、读取 transcript、向会话发送一条 prompt。对话只存在本插件本地数据目录，插件自身不联网。

author: VastSa
changelog: Release 0.1.0: first release. Docked side chat with local history, host-owned completions, optional session context, and send-to-session.
safetyNotes: Uses your already signed-in models through the host (agent.complete); the plugin never sees API keys. desktop.control lets it list sessions, read a transcript, and send a prompt into a session. Conversations are stored only in this plugin's local data directory. No network of its own.

settings.title: Attach session by default
settings.description: Include the selected session transcript when sending a side-chat message.
